import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
customer_segments = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Select relevant columns for the visualization
data = customer_segments[['Income', 'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds', 'Z_Revenue', 'Response']]

# Create a pairplot to visualize relationships between variables
plt.figure(figsize=(15, 10))
sns.pairplot(data, vars=['Income', 'MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds', 'Z_Revenue'], hue='Response', markers=['o', 'x'])
plt.title('Customer Segmentation Pairplot')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
